verdict.rationale: A compliance calendar is a fair question for an incorporation and post-formation filing service, but the evidence never documents a calendar of upcoming filing deadlines or reminders before them. The 'Compliance API' mention is limited to Enterprise plans and has no description of deadline tracking. The webhooks only report completed notarization or appointment events, and the post-formation filings are one-time submissions rather than tracked recurring deadlines; these are adjacent features that earn no credit.
